title.value: Task-Agnostic Continual Reinforcement Learning: Gaining Insights and Overcoming Challenges
title.justification: The title is directly taken from the paper's main title section, which reflects the core focus on task-agnostic continual reinforcement learning.
title.quote: T ASK -A GNOSTIC C ONTINUAL R EINFORCEMENT L EARNING : G AINING I NSIGHTS AND O VERCOMING C HALLENGES

extractions.description: This paper explores task-agnostic continual learning (CL) in reinforcement learning settings. It investigates the differences in performance between task-agnostic CL and multi-task learning (MTL) approaches, with an emphasis on the potential advantages of task-agnostic methods. The authors introduce a replay-based recurrent reinforcement learning (3RL) methodology and demonstrate its effectiveness across synthetic tasks and Meta-World benchmarks.
